title: OpEnvelope (DRAFT v2 — NOT part of the frozen prototype surface)
description: DRAFT. Versioned, batched mutation protocol planned for the post-prototype milestone (see docs/SCALABILITY.md §5, debt D-03). Purely ADDITIVE: it stands beside the frozen per-command surface; no existing schema or command changes. `applyBatch` is the argument of the future ops_apply command; `committedBatch` is what ops_subscribe streams to every window. Op payloads are intentionally open (additionalProperties true) so op kinds can be added without breaking validators (avoids re-creating debt D-06).

rev.description: Monotonic project-session revision number. Rev N+1 is the state after applying committed batch N+1 to state rev N.

op.title: Op
op.description: One mutation. `kind` is an open namespaced string (e.g. "track.setGain", "clip.move", "param.set"); unknown kinds must be rejected by the applier but tolerated by observers. Payload fields beyond these are kind-specific.

target.description: Primary target entity UUID (track, clip, node, ...), when the kind has one.

transient.description: True for intermediate values of a continuous gesture (knob drag, scrub): latest-wins, not journaled, not undoable on its own. The gesture's final op omits this / sets false.

applyBatch.title: ApplyBatch
applyBatch.description: Argument of ops_apply. Applied atomically: all ops commit as one revision (one undo entry, at most one graph swap) or the batch is rejected as a whole.

protocol.description: Op-protocol version this client speaks. This draft describes version 2.

baseRev.description: Revision the client built this batch against; null = unconditional (server rebases trivially or rejects on conflict, policy per kind).

label.description: Optional human-readable gesture label for the undo history (e.g. "Move 12 clips").

committedBatch.title: CommittedBatch
committedBatch.description: Streamed over the Channel passed to ops_subscribe, in strict rev order, to every subscriber (including the originator, which reconciles its optimistic state).

origin.description: Opaque id of the submitting client/window/session; lets the originator recognize its own batches.
